description: Full briefing markdown + metadata for one edition. ``slug`` is the YYYY-MM-DD edition date from list_digests; omitting it returns the LATEST edition. The payload also carries ``export_html_url`` and ``export_pdf_url`` — pregenerated offline downloads of the edition ready to fetch. Pass ``region`` (the regional pilot, same as the site's ?region=) for a region's view: a generated per-region edition when one exists, else the master filtered to that region; ``regions`` in the payload lists what the edition offers.

lang.description: Localized briefing (es / zh) when a translation exists; omit for English

region.description: Regional view of the briefing (na / emea / apac / latam); omit for the global edition

slug.description: YYYY-MM-DD edition date (from list_digests); omit for the latest

name: get_digest

export_html_url.description: URL of the pregenerated offline HTML export (a single self-contained file: briefing + bundled episode summaries)

export_pdf_url.description: URL of the pregenerated offline PDF export (the same document, print-rendered)

lang.description: The language actually served ('' = English original)

region.description: The applied regional view ('' = the global edition)

region_note.description: Set when a requested region filter emptied the view

title: Read one edition
